collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 5-13 and another child; in the story (name1) has vitiligo, with pale patches on (his/her) dark skin)

collection.description: A child has named the pale patches of their vitiligo like a map of islands: ask for the tour, or make a map of your own.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has vitiligo: patches of pale skin scattered across (subject.his/her) dark arms, hands and one cheek, like little islands. Today (subject.he/she) has decided that's exactly what they are. (subject.He/she) has been naming them. The big one on (subject.his/her) elbow is Home Island. The little ones on (subject.his/her) wrist are the Three Sisters. (friend) wants to hear the whole map.

choices.label: Make a Map of Your Own

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) doesn't have any islands, so (friend.he/she) borrows some charcoal and draws freckle-sized ones all over (friend.his/her) own arms. They compare maps. (subject) is extremely clear that (subject.his/her) own are real and (friend)'s are pretend. (friend) agrees. By evening (friend)'s islands have mostly smudged off. (subject)'s are exactly where they were, which (subject) points out several times.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) goes through every single island, with stories. One is where the fish are biggest. One is where nobody is allowed to be sad. One on (subject.his/her) knee is a volcano, and it's erupting, which is why it itches. (friend) is enchanted. (friend.He/she) asks if (friend.he/she) can visit. "You need a canoe," (subject) says gravely. They build one out of a leaf.
